items.text: In published test-negative studies of seasonal influenza vaccine effectiveness from 2010 onward, how were case definition, test type, specimen timing, calendar time, repeat testing, prior vaccination, vaccination source and SARS-CoV-2-positive controls handled and reported?
items.population: Test-negative studies of seasonal influenza vaccine effectiveness
items.context: Published studies from 2010 onward, any setting, with post-2020 items for test type and SARS-CoV-2 controls

finer: Feasible with a registrar for three months and library support; interesting to the agency's laboratories and epidemiologists; novel in covering the post-2020 period; no participants; relevant to the May 2027 protocol.
summary: One PCC question for the scoping review.
